```{r}
yearly <- storm_data2 %>% 
  group_by(YEAR) %>% #grouping by year
  summarise(avg_lat = mean(BEGIN_LAT, na.rm = TRUE), avg_lon = mean(BEGIN_LON, na.rm = TRUE) ) %>% #finding avg beginning latitude per year
  arrange(YEAR) #arranging chronologically

#plotting avg lat and lon over years
ggplot(yearly, aes(x=YEAR, y=avg_lat)) + geom_point() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x)
ggplot(yearly, aes(x=YEAR, y=avg_lon)) + geom_point() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x)
```

```{r}
#creating new variable for the mid point of the tornado's lat and long
storm_data3 <- storm_data2 %>% mutate(midLAT = (BEGIN_LAT + END_LAT)/2, midLON = (BEGIN_LON + END_LON)/2)
yearly2 <- storm_data3 %>% 
  group_by(YEAR) %>% #grouping by year
  summarise(avg_lat = mean(midLAT, na.rm = TRUE), avg_lon = mean(midLON, na.rm = TRUE) ) %>% #finding avg latitude per year
  arrange(YEAR) #arranging chronologically

#plotting midpoint lat and long by year
ggplot(yearly2, aes(x=YEAR, y=avg_lat)) + geom_point() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x)
ggplot(yearly2, aes(x=YEAR, y=avg_lon)) + geom_point() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x)


```

```{r}
summary(lm_mod)
```

```{r}
#heat map reflecting tornado frequency

us_states <- st_as_sf(map("state", plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE))
ggplot() +
  # Map layer knows to use the internal geometry column
  geom_sf(data = us_states, fill = "gray95", color = "white") + 
  
  # Heatmap layer explicitly handles your data frame variables
  stat_density_2d(
    data = storm_data3, 
    aes(x = midLON, y = midLAT, fill = after_stat(level)), 
    geom = "polygon", 
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-125, -67), ylim = c(24, 50))
```
```{r}

#asked AI for assistance creating a heat map with US overlay, and looping over 40 years
us_states <- st_as_sf(map("state", plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE))

years <- 1986:2026

for (yr in years) {
  
  data_yr <- storm_data3 %>% filter(YEAR == yr)
  
  # skip years with too few points to fit a density surface
  if (nrow(data_yr) < 5) {
    message("Skipping ", yr, ": only ", nrow(data_yr), " rows")
    next
  }
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = us_states, fill = "gray95", color = "white") +
    stat_density_2d(
      data = data_yr,
      aes(x = midLON, y = midLAT, fill = after_stat(level)),
      geom = "polygon",
      alpha = 0.4
    ) +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(-125, -67), ylim = c(24, 50)) +
    labs(title = paste("Storm Density —", yr)) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("storm_density_", yr, ".png"),
    plot = p,
    width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 150
  )
}
```

```{r}
#asked for ai help getting fips in the same format
# Keep countypop$fips as a zero-padded character string (do NOT convert to numeric)
countypop <- countypop %>%
  mutate(fips = str_pad(as.character(fips), 5, pad = "0"))

storm_data3 <- storm_data3 %>%
  mutate(
    STATE_FIPS = str_pad(STATE_FIPS, 2, pad = "0"),
    CZ_FIPS = str_pad(CZ_FIPS, 3, pad = "0")
  ) %>%
  unite("full_fips", STATE_FIPS, CZ_FIPS, sep = "", remove = FALSE)

# Join on the correct key: full_fips == fips
tornadopop <- inner_join(storm_data3, countypop, by = join_by(full_fips == fips))
tornadopop <- inner_join(tornadopop, countypov, by = join_by(full_fips == fips))
tornadopop

#got AI help getting property damage into numeric format
parse_damage <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(x)
  num <- as.numeric(str_extract(x, "^[0-9.]+"))
  mult <- case_when(
    str_detect(x, "K$") ~ 1e3,
    str_detect(x, "M$") ~ 1e6,
    str_detect(x, "B$") ~ 1e9,
    TRUE ~ 1
  )
  num * mult
}

tornadopop <- tornadopop %>%
  mutate(DAMAGE_PROPERTY_num = parse_damage(DAMAGE_PROPERTY))


```


```{r}

summary(propmod)
```

```{r}
#asked AI, helped me group to find count of tornados in a state over a period of five years

tornadopop <- tornadopop %>%
  mutate(
    YEAR = as.integer(str_sub(as.character(BEGIN_YEARMONTH), 1, 4)),
    period = (YEAR %/% 5) * 5
  )

state_period_counts <- tornadopop %>%
  filter(CZ_TYPE == "C") %>%
  group_by(STATE, period) %>%
  summarise(n_tornadoes = n(), .groups = "drop")

# reconcile state naming (STATE is full caps name, need abbr to match countypop conventions)
state_lookup <- tibble(state_name = toupper(state.name), abbr = state.abb)

state_period_counts <- state_period_counts %>%
  left_join(state_lookup, by = c("STATE" = "state_name"))

all_periods <- unique(state_period_counts$period)

# grid of every state x every period, so zero-tornado state-periods are included
full_grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(abbr = state.abb, period = all_periods)

state_period_full <- full_grid %>%
  left_join(state_period_counts %>% dplyr::select(abbr, period, n_tornadoes),
            by = c("abbr", "period")) %>%
  mutate(n_tornadoes = replace_na(n_tornadoes, 0))
```


```{r}
train <-state_period_full %>% filter(period <= 2000)
test  <- state_period_full %>% filter(period > 2000)

table(train$period)
table(test$period)

pois_model <- glm(n_tornadoes ~ abbr +  period, family = poisson(link = "log"), data = train)
summary(pois_model)

```


```{r}

#asked AI how to do a negative binomial model

nb_model <- glm.nb(
  n_tornadoes ~ abbr +  period,
  data = train
)
summary(nb_model)

```
```{r}
linear_model <- lm(
  n_tornadoes ~ abbr + period,
  data = train
)
summary(linear_model)

```

```{r}
AIC(pois_model, nb_model, linear_model)

test$predicted_full    <- predict(pois_model,  newdata = test, type = "response")
mean(abs(test$n_tornadoes - test$predicted_full))

test$predicted_nb   <- predict(nb_model,  newdata = test, type = "response")
mean(abs(test$n_tornadoes - test$predicted_nb))

test$predicted_lin   <- predict(linear_model,  newdata = test, type = "response")
mean(abs(test$n_tornadoes - test$predicted_lin))
```
